category_title: Year 9 boys with SEBD who resist modified games and technical practice
scenario_title: Introducing technical skill drills and paired work
minimal_context: The student is asked to participate in a paired technical skill drill during a Physical Education class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to focus on technical practice. Please get into pairs and start the passing skill drill.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to do it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to work with a partner for this activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Wanders aimlessly away from the equipment) I'm not doing paired stuff.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come back here and start the drill.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Refuses to engage with the teacher, calls out, and interferes with another group's ball) I told you I don't want to do it! I'm not doing this paired stuff!
